units: <cite ref="Shabbat 146b:2">Sabb. 146ᵇ</cite> <he>שניקבה למטה מן הש׳</he> when the jug has a hole below the line of the lees.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 96b:3">B. Bath. 96ᵇ</cite> <he>שִׁמְרֵי יין</he> wine lees.
<cite ref="Bava Batra 96b:3">Ib.</cite> <he>ש׳ … טעם יין</he> lees which have a taste (or flavor) of wine.

<cite ref="Mishnah Bava Metzia 4:11">B. Mets. IV, 11</cite> <he>אין מערבין שמרי … שְׁמָרָיו</he> you dare not mix wine lees (left of one jug) with wine, but you may give the purchaser the lees belonging to the wine sold; a. fr.
